integrity.about: What hits do to the ship (src/carrier/integrity.mjs). Every compartment is a volume of air (kPa) with a health. `air`: `nominal` pressure; pressure doors close when either side falls below `doorsShut`, and open by hand only if the two sides are within `openWithin`; below `unsafe` a room shows as without air, below `faint` you black out after `blackout` seconds; `falling` is the kPa a second that counts as losing air; life support puts back `refill` kPa a second; `through` is how freely air passes an open doorway (m/s); `wind` the fastest you are pulled toward a hole. `hole.flow` is how fast air leaves through a hole to space (m/s, about the speed of sound's share in choked flow). `shell`: the ranges a hit is dealt from: `pen` metres through the ship, `damage` health taken, `hole` area in m². `drones` seal holes: `count` of them in the `from` room, `speed` m/s, `seal` seconds for a 0.1 m² hole, `inside` is no longer read: a hole between compartments is a damage control party's (`parts.parties`); the drones fly out of the bay and round her (`parts.drones`). `patch.work` is the seconds of holding E to patch a hole yourself. Below `power.below` of reactor health the ship is on emergency power. `attack`: seconds to the first and between raids, how many hits in one, the seconds of warning, and the seconds after the last hit before the ship stands down from action stations (all pressure doors are kept shut until then). `jobs`: the chance a damaging hit starts a fire, an electrical fault or a coolant leak, and the health a finished job puts back. `armour`: the belt round her; a gun shell is stopped by it (a scar, no hole) `stop` of the time, and one that gets through has lost `pen` metres (a torpedo is never stopped). `armour.structure`: the same for the open drum section's exposed structure (the spine, the hub rings, the spokes and the end struts, `drum.structure`), reached through the sleeve's open ends. `condition`: condition one, set at action stations: `warn` seconds after the call, the air in every walkable compartment is pumped down to `to` kPa at `pump` kPa a second (into the tanks, not lost), so a hit cannot blow a room out or start a fire; after the stand-down it comes back at `repress` kPa a second. Everyone suits up first. `drums`: false keeps the drums' rooms and ring corridors pressurised (only the fixed hull is pumped down). `suit`: the duty suit everyone wears outside the drums (changed into at the lockers by each drum's lift; the `suit` kit is its fresh bottles) holds `air` seconds of breathing, warns at `low`, and takes `don` seconds to put on; with your helmet on, the room's air does not matter to you.

parts.about: The carrier's outside parts and how she is mended (src/carrier/carrier-damage.mjs, carrier-repair.mjs). Each kind (`kinds`) has health 100 and is mended `by` the drones (outside) or a damage control party (inside), taking `min` + `per` × what it has lost / 100 seconds. `radiator`: plant.mjs's two panels, shedding heat as they are unhurt. `rcs`: each manoeuvring cluster (a ball `r` m round it), pushing nothing under `off` health and all it can from `full`. `turret`: each turret (a ball `r`), out of action under `out`. `pdc`: each point defence and flak mount (a ball `r`; its health is the gun's own `hp`), out under `out`. `door`: each bay door, jammed where it stands under `jam`. `bearing`: each drum's bearing, hit through its hub ring (`structure` of the shell's damage), shuddering under `shudder` (the drum wobbles `wobble` rad at worst). A gun shell takes `shell` health from a part it meets (a radiator 0.6 of that); a torpedo's blast every part within `torpedo.r` m, `torpedo.hp` at the blast and less with distance. A holed propellant tank vents its leak (plant.propellant.leak) at `leak.ve` m/s, which pushes her. Jobs are taken in `order` (the worst hit first within a kind): `tank` (a hole in a propellant tank), `breach` (into a room with air), `inside` (between two compartments, a party's), `hole` (into a sealed space); the rest are the kinds. `drones`: out of the bay's hatch at `exit` (her frame) going `out`, round her `clear` m off her hull and spread radiators, at up to `cruise` m/s and `accel` m/s² (steering time constant `tau`), through each waypoint within `pass` m at `corner` m/s, holding `standoff` m off the work; drawn `scale` times the hangar's drones. Their number, bay and seal time are `integrity.drones`. `parties`: `count` of them from the `from` room, timed at `speed` m/s along their way (climbs count 1.5×) after `setup` s. You can do any inside job with the `kit`, adding `help` (a party is 1).
